hook: AT YOUR LOWEST,|ONLY THOSE WHO|DO THIS RISE

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Two people lose <#0.2#> the same job in the same year.
voices.caption: Two people lose the same job in the same year.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: One spends years <#0.2#> resenting the world.
voices.caption: One spends years resenting the world.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: The other spends that time <#0.2#> learning, and building something.
voices.caption: The other spends that time learning, and building something.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Years later, <#0.3#> they live completely different lives.
voices.caption: Years later, they live completely different lives.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Same bottom. <#0.2#> The difference was what they did with that time.
voices.caption: Same bottom. The difference was what they did with that time.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: If you're at the bottom, <#0.2#> learn one more thing.
voices.caption: If you're at the bottom, learn one more thing.
